# openai_tenant_workload_identity_federation_rule (Data Source)

Beta. Retrieve a tenant workload identity federation rule. Requires tenant.workload_identity.read.

Authentication: Set the tenant_admin_api_key provider attribute or OPENAI_TENANT_ADMIN_KEY environment variable for the tenant API audience; with a custom tenant_base_url, set the tenant_admin_api_key provider attribute explicitly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openai_tenant_workload_identity_federation_rule" "example" {
  workload_identity_provider_id        = "workload_identity_provider_123"
  workload_identity_federation_rule_id = "workload_identity_federation_rule_123"
}
```
